description: Tracks a submitted procedure's 処理状況 + 法定処理期間 clock + result (ADR-2605312030 §3, `toritsugi_status_track`). On refusal / partial outcome, routes a lawful appeal (不服申立 / 審査請求) via chigiri (G11). CONSTITUTIONAL: assist + track only, no coercion (G11); the result / 結果通知 PII lands ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds status metadata + pointers, never inline PII.

submissionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the submissionRecord being tracked

dueAt.description: 法定処理期間 deadline derived from the procedure's statutoryProcessingDays

resultRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the 結果通知 / outcome detail (G6); never inline PII

appealRef.description: On refusal/partial: reference to the chigiri-routed lawful appeal (不服申立/審査請求) record (G11)
